g.title: HR_APPRAISALFORM
g.text: Appraisal Form - This entity stores the appraisal form model or template that will be used during an evaluation.
The identifier of the Analytic record.
Whether a banner should be displayed at the top of the appraisal form.
The title shown in the banner
This field identifies the image to be used as a background.
This is a link to a Topic (article) that can be used as a Tutorial during the assessment.
In this field you can define a text resource for the Tutorial button.
Identify which assessment component is linked to this section
Indicates if individual appraisals based on this form template will also generate an individual payout.
When this flag is activated, the user can open the analytics page from the form.
When this flag is active, the Appraisal review header section, including the participant, reviewer and other review information will be visible.
When this flag is activated, the section containing the Component review scores will be visible.
This flag determines if the reviews by other reviewers are visible.
This flag determines if the reviews by additional reviewers are visible.
Show review comment in edit mode
This property is useful to turn on or off the properties: hide Emoji Picker, hide Comment Full Name, hide Comment Like and hide Comment Operations
When this flag is active, the Appraisal Review Header section shows detailed information.
This field indicates the report to be used for printing.
This flag indicates if the form is used for team rating.
This flag indicates if all review sections are collapsed.
This flag indicates if the Discussion Thread is Active
Number of Decimal Places of the Weight.
Indicates the date and time of creation
Indicates the user who has created it
Indicates the IP address from which it was created
Indicates the date and time of last update operation
Indicates the user who has executed last update
Indicates the IP address from which was executed last update
Indicates how many update was executed since its creation

g.title: HR_ASSESMENTCOMPONENT
g.text: Generate a classification as a matrix
Defines whether the component score is displayed as a percentage.
Applies only if “Percentage” has been selected; used to display divergence above or below 100%, e.g. 93% as -7%, 105% as +5%
Display the component score as number.
Display the component result as discrete value (drop down list).
Defines whether the score is displayed as a star rating.
This field specify the page that will be used to render the component score.
Indicates the date and time of creation
Indicates the user who has created it
Indicates the IP address from which it was created
Indicates the date and time of last update operation
Indicates the user who has executed last update
Indicates the IP address from which was executed last update
Indicates how many update was executed since its creation

g.title: HR_APPRAISALCYCLE
g.text: Appraisal Cycle - This Entity allows defining a container of Appraisals that make sense on a specific period for a given employee set.
The identifier of the Appraisal Type record.
The validity start date for an historical situation.
The validity end date for an historical situation.
This field contains the identifier of the master cycle record.
Indicates the status of the appraisal cycle.
The identifier of the entity set of participants.
This field contains the task id for the creation of the appraisal participants.
This field contains the task id for the kick-off of the cycle appraisal.
The identifier of the scheduled task for the opportunity creation.
The identifier of the scheduled task of the payout calculation.
The identifier of the scheduled task of the reviews deletion.
Indicates the date and time of creation
Indicates the user who has created it
Indicates the IP address from which it was created
Indicates the date and time of last update operation
Indicates the user who has executed last update
Indicates the IP address from which was executed last update
Indicates how many update was executed since its creation
Indicates whether the participants of this appraisal cycle are evaluated by only one reviewer.
Calibration models to calculate evaluation scores based on an expected distribution
Validation Status of an appraisal cycle
Id of the related validation task

g.title: HR_CYCLEPARTICREVIEWER
g.text: Cycle Participant Reviewer - Contains reviewers/evaluators of cycle participants.
The person who issued the assessment.
The user group in charge of an assessment.
Indicates the weighting as a percentage
The appraisal form to be used
Indicates the date and time of creation
Indicates the user who has created it
Indicates the IP address from which it was created
Indicates the date and time of last update operation
Indicates the user who has executed last update
Indicates the IP address from which was executed last update
Indicates how many update was executed since its creation

g.title: HR_APPRAISALFORMPAYOUT
g.text: Appraisal Form Payout - This entity contains the payout configuration associated with an appraisal form.
The identifier of appraisal form record.
Refers to the compensation item to which the bonus target will be assigned.
Determines if the payout is calculated taking the overall score achievement or the sum of payouts associated to the sections below.
The identifier of the Payout Guideline.
Indicates the final percentage that will be applied to the payout.
This flag indicates if the opportunity can be seen on the appraisal form.
This flag indicates if the opportunity can be changed in the appraisal form.
This flag indicates if the payout can be seen on the appraisal form.
This flag indicates if the payout can be changed in the appraisal form.
This flag enables the payout amount calculation each time the appraisal is saved. If, instead, the payout is triggered at Appraisal Cycle level, then disable this flag.
This field describes the calculation model used for the payout.
Indicates the date and time of creation
Indicates the user who has created it
Indicates the IP address from which it was created
Indicates the date and time of last update operation
Indicates the user who has executed last update
Indicates the IP address from which was executed last update
Indicates how many update was executed since its creation

g.title: HR_APPRAISALFORMSECTION
g.text: Appraisal Form Section - This entity contains the section definition within an appraisal form.
The appraisal form to be used
Identify which assessment component is linked to this section
The name to be displayed for the section
This field shows how the weightings are distributed across elements in the same section.
Indicates the weight of the section.
The Compentency Grid to be used
The Identifier of the Job record.
When the section type is questionnaire, this field stores the reference to a questionnaire in the catalogue.
description of field training plan for entity appraisal form section
This field indicate which rating scale will be used for the evaluation.
The identifier of the Appraisal Objective Categories record.
description of field objective plan for entity appraisal form section
description of field objective source for entity appraisal form section
description of field default objective type for entity appraisal form section
The identifier of appraisal role record.
States that the section is scored.
Using this flag, the system will use a remote service to retrieve a sentiment score based on analysis of the section comments, which will be displayed on the related components.
If true the section will be read only for the reviewer.
When true it will be possible to add an element in the section.
When true you can add only the Type you chose in Objective Type dropdown
Defines the minumum number of items that should be included in the section. If set, a validation rule is enabled.
Defines the maximum number of items that can be included in the section. If set, a validation rule is enabled.
This flag enables manual adjustment of the score.
Defines whether the component score is displayed as a percentage.
Applies only if “Percentage” has been selected; used to display divergence above or below 100%, e.g. 93% as -7%, 105% as +5%
Display the component score as number.
Display the component result as discrete value (drop down list).
Defines the default evaluation method that will be displayed during the appraisal.
It is the flag to include B.A.R.S. in the appraisal form section.
The identifier of the Analytic record.

With this field is possible to specify the source of a competency section of an appraisal form; a choice between a specific Competency Grid, Competencies from the primary Job of the evaluated person, or Competencies from a specific Job.
This field indicates if the payout is enabled on current section form.
This field indicates the percentage of opportunity per section.
description of field copy results for entity appraisal form section
The identifier of the Payout Guideline.
This field indicates if all items must be completed when saving the form.
Score Not Found Default Scale Value
Publish component score in the person component profile
Widget page to be shown inside appraisal person additional info section
This field determines whether the section will be generated in the evaluation or not.
Indicates the date and time of creation
Indicates the user who has created it
Indicates the IP address from which it was created
Indicates the date and time of last update operation
Indicates the user who has executed last update
Indicates the IP address from which was executed last update
Indicates how many update was executed since its creation

g.title: HR_APPRAISALTYPE
g.text: Appraisal Type - Defines information relating to an appraisal type such as the default form to be used for the specifc appraisal type and other properties, e.g. main component for the associated appraisals, eligibility group, security settings.
The name of the appraisal type.
The validity start date for an historical situation.
The validity end date for an historical situation.
Defines the main component for the appraisal type.
This field indicates what the default rating scale will be for the evaluation.
If true this type of evaluation will allow more than one reviewer.
This is the default appraisal form that will be inherited when selecting the current appraisal type.
The set of people eligible by default for the appraisal type.
The funtional area of the appraisal type.
This field enables a user to make the appraisal type available only for the selected context.
This field allow to specify the visibility setting for Managers, this could depend by review role or could be opened for all the appraisal having the specific type.
This field allow to specify the visibility setting for Employees, this could depend by reviewer role or could be opened for all the appraisal having the specific type.
Indicates whether a Manager can see the draft appraisal of a reviewee in their Appraisal History page.
Indicates whether an Employee can see their own draft appraisal in their Appraisal History page.
Indicates the date and time of creation
Indicates the user who has created it
Indicates the IP address from which it was created
Indicates the date and time of last update operation
Indicates the user who has executed last update
Indicates the IP address from which was executed last update
Indicates how many update was executed since its creation
